args.description: Analyze the PostgreSQL database for the user's question: 'What are the biggest tables?'. Return a ranked list of the biggest tables by total size, including table size, index size, toast size if relevant, and total size. If exact row counts are readily available from catalog stats, include them; otherwise omit. Focus on the top tables only (e.g., top 10). Include any caveats about statistics freshness if relevant. Use the inventory-analyst subagent's storage analysis capabilities. Output concise, ready to relay to the user.
